name: figma-mcp-monorepo
description: Figma MCP Server and Figma Companion Plugin for AI-driven prototyping and UI/UX design

scripts.clean:port: powershell -Command "$p = (Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 3055 -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue).OwningProcess; if ($p) { Stop-Process -Id $p -Force; Write-Host 'Port 3055 freed' } else { Write-Host 'Port 3055 is already free' }"
